item.title: Two-vehicle crash on Highway 504 in Oak Grove causes brief delays
item.description: A two-vehicle crash on La. Hwy. 504 at Hanna Drive in Oak Grove caused brief traffic delays on Jan. 15, according to the Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office. The crash occurred around 8 a.m. and resulted in non-life-threatening injuries. item.title: The price of secrecy: Natchitoches taxpayers paid $69,000+ to hide public records
item.description: The final tally is in, and it’s staggering: The City of Natchitoches spent additional $57,636 in taxpayer funds to prevent citizens from accessing public records they were legally entitled to see. item.title: Word of the Day: Parsimonious
item.description: Phonetic: /pahr-suh-moh-nee-uhs/ Part of Speech: Adjective Definition “parsimonious thrift relieved by few generous impulses” A parsimonious person is unwilling to spend a lot of money. You know those people who count up every penny when it’s time to split a restaurant bill? You can call them parsimonious. Or cheap.
